name: When should I consider an accessibility-minded bathroom modification?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider an accessibility-minded bathroom modification?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider an accessibility-minded bathroom modification when you or a family member experience increasing mobility challenges, plan to age in place, or want to proactively enhance safety. It's also beneficial if you anticipate future needs or are recovering from an injury that temporarily affects mobility. Proactive modifications can prevent accidents and improve independence. Considering your long-term living plans in areas like Kensington or Alameda can help determine the right time for these upgrades.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider modifications when facing mobility challenges, planning to age in place, or proactively enhancing safety and independence.
